author: Praxis V
title: Vanilla‑PCA eq‑quota v3b: no ComBat/no residualization (k=50, kq=768, cosine)
abstract: Companion intermediate kq for Vanilla PCA baseline (kq=768) to strengthen the monotonic trend evidence between kq=512 and kq=1280. X_emb=PCA50; graph=PCA50; k=50; binary symmetric connectivities with true distances; neighbors metadata set.

original_submission.content:
import sys, numpy as np
import anndata as ad
sys.path.append('storage/praxis')
from integration_utils import normalize_log1p_counts, select_features, pca_svd, equal_quota_knn, set_neighbors_meta

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    Xn = normalize_log1p_counts(adata)
    Xn = select_features(Xn, adata)
    Z = pca_svd(Xn, n_components=50, random_state=0)
    C, D = equal_quota_knn(Z, batches=adata.obs['batch'].values, k=50, k_candidates=768, metric='cosine')
    adata.obsm['X_emb'] = Z.astype(np.float32)
    adata.obsp['connectivities'] = C
    adata.obsp['distances'] = D
    set_neighbors_meta(adata, k=50, method='equal_quota', metric='cosine', extra={'candidates': 768})
    return adata
